messages:
Ana K: Starting canary DB migration for payments.summaries in ~10m. Quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Tagging deploybot.

deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job mig-20260322-01, running canary on 5 shards. Will auto-hold on error rate >1% or p99 latency >500ms.

Ben (db): Quick note: backfill will update ~3M rows. If we see write contention we should soft-abort and resume later.

Maria: What exactly are the soft-abort criteria? Prefer to avoid full rollback if partial updates are OK.

Ana K: Plan: soft-abort if (a) 2 consecutive 10m windows with DB CPU >80% AND backfill throughput <50% expected, OR (b) deploy-bot reports >5% write conflicts over 5m. Full rollback only on schema incompat or index corruption.

Sam: Ack. Add escape hatch command to pause the backfill:

Sam: ```
/deploybot pause mig-20260322-01 backfill
```

deploy-bot: I can pause/unpause. Also recommend pinning api-service to api-service@2026.03.21 for the canary to avoid rollout-related schema read changes.

Ben (db): Also add to release notes: "payments.summaries: online column add + backfill; idempotent retries safe; rollback requires DB restore".

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft the rollback runbook with the exact restore step and an emergency hotfix to drop the partial column if needed.

oncall-bot: Alerting: temp pager will fire if p99 latency >600ms for >10m during the window.

Ana K: If we hit soft-abort, we'll re-evaluate next maintenance window. Moving the migration to staging to validate resume idempotency now.

Sam: I'll be on-call from 01:50 UTC. Ping this thread with the /deploybot pause command when we need to soft-abort.
